intuition: Sorted candidates allow duplicate choices to be skipped and sums that exceed the target to stop early.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate every subset and retain combinations whose values sum to the target.

optimal.approach: Backtrack using each candidate at most once, skipping equal values at the same depth and pruning oversized sums.

edge_cases: No subset may reach the target.
Repeated candidate values can be used only as many times as they occur.
